behaviors.description: Approve a pending A-to-B update with closed stdin using either automatic mode.
behaviors.preconditions: Known A deployment and an independent B app commit available from the same remote.
behaviors.expected: An ordinary unapproved update preserves A; each automatic mode reaches exact B while preserving the runtime and suppressing the confirmation prompt.

mappings.rationale: The changed app commit distinguishes a completed update from an already-current no-op.

surface_assertions.rationale: The pending update completes with closed stdin after an ordinary refusal.
The pending update completes without input or an unanswered prompt.
